business_summary: CJ Seafood Corporation produces and processes seafood products in South Korea. The company offers fish cake, meat, seaweed, and refrigerated/frozen food products. It sells its products under the Samho Fish Cake brand names. The company was formerly known as Samho F&G, Inc. and changed its name to CJ Seafood Corporation in 2010. CJ Seafood Corporation was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: CJ Seafood Corporation은 한국에서 수산물을 생산 및 가공합니다. 어묵, 육류, 해초, 냉장/냉동 식품을 판매하는 회사입니다. 삼호어묵 브랜드로 제품을 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 삼호F&G, Inc.로 알려져 있었고 2010년에 CJ Seafood Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. CJ Seafood Corporation은 1976년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 성남시에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
